meta.parties: Attorney General v. Chandran and Another

rules.statement: The act of re-entering premises after vacating them and handing over the keys to a landlord's agent constitutes wrongful entry if done with intent to annoy or intimidate the new occupant.
rules.supporting_quote: "Thereupon Jeevananda Silva as agent took charge and he came into 'occupation' though he was not physically residing therein. In this connection the case of Ukku Singho v. Andiris Silva (6) is almost directly in point."
